_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
E te taʻalo Golf (Kāti Taʻaloga) - Player {player_id}.
Malia: Pulea le scori e tatau i lenei faʻataʻitaʻiga. Afai e faʻaopoopo le tulaga, latou te faʻaopoopo e pei o le 0.
Kāti Values: A=1, 2-10=faʻaalia, J/Q=10, K=0

Gaoioiga (faʻaaoga le bracketed): 
- '[draw]' - Sau mai le deck 
- '[take]' - Sau mai le pile o discards 
- '[swap X Y]' - Palasi le kāti saunia ma le tulaga X (row) Y (column) 
- '[discard]' - Discard le kāti saunia

board.drew:
Na e sau: {card}
O lou filifiliga o [swap X Y] poʻo [discard]
board.took:
You took: {card} from discard pile
You must [swap X Y] with it (cannot discard).
board.peeked: Na e vaʻai i le tulaga ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Faʻaiuga o faʻataʻitaʻiga! Ou filifiliga: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: E tatau ona: [swap X Y] (e lē mafai ona lafoaʻi pepa mai le faaputuga o mea e te lafoaia)
options.swap_or_discard: E tatau ona e: [swap X Y] poʻo [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} palasi {new} ma {old} i le tulaga ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Ua leai se isi i luga o le laupapa! E vave ona faaiʻu le taaloga.
message.knocked: Player {pid} knocked! Ia tagata taʻalo uma e mafai ona toe faia se tasi
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Ia tagata taʻalo uma e mafai ona toe faia se tasi

reason.all_revealed: ua faaalia uma ai pepa o loo iai?

invalid.wrong_action: Faʻaaoga le tasi le bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], poʻo [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Ua leai se mea o loo iai i le faaputuga e lafoaʻi!
invalid.must_draw_first: E tatau ona e muamua [draw], [take], [knock], poʻo [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: E lē mafai ona e lafoaʻia se pepa mai le faaputuga o kata ua uma ona ave, ae ia sui.
invalid.have_drawn_card: E iai lou kāti kāti. E tatau ona e [swap X Y] poʻo [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: E manaʻomia se pepa e tusi ai le taulima ina ia mafai ona faafesuiaʻi.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: E manaʻomia se pepa ua tusia e lafoaʻi.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Tulaga i fafo o le paepae. Faʻaaoga le row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: E lē mafai ona e tuʻituʻi atu i se pepa ua uma ona tāina. Ia faauma muamua lau vili.

invalid.already_revealed: Ua uma ona faailoa mai lenā kata!
